name: High Feudal Castle Keep
description: Erect a formidable multi-towered stone castle with curtain walls, dry moat, and grand banquet hall.
creativePrompt: Which dynasty commissioned this fortress? What legendary siege tested its outer battlements?
exampleNarrative: Towering stone keeps rose above the cliffs, their heraldic banners snapping in the wind as sentries paced the battlements.

name: Imperial Walled Capital & Highways
description: Expand a town into a monumental stone capital with grand forums, paved roads, and garrison districts.
creativePrompt: How many citizens inhabit the metropolis? What grand gates face the four cardinal directions?
exampleNarrative: Imperial avenues paved with granite slabs radiated from the grand forum, connecting millions under one sovereign law.

name: Mountain Bastion Citadel
description: Crown a jagged alpine pinnacle with an impregnable rock citadel commanding key mountain passes.
creativePrompt: How are supplies winched up to the eagle aerie? Who guards the secret escape tunnels?
exampleNarrative: Perched upon a jagged granite fang, the citadel looked down upon three kingdoms, unassailable by storm or siege.

name: Deepwater Grand Harbor & Docks
description: Construct stone breakwaters, lighthouses, drydocks, and merchant warehouses in a natural deepwater bay.
creativePrompt: What exotic spices and ores fill the quayside warehouses? What naval flags dominate the docks?
exampleNarrative: Stone quays stretched deep into the bay, where hundreds of masted caravels unloaded silks, iron, and wine from across the seas.

name: Monumental Arched Stone Bridge
description: Build a soaring multi-arched masonry bridge spanning a violent river canyon or sea strait.
creativePrompt: How many years did architects take to anchor the center caissons against the torrent?
exampleNarrative: Seven graceful granite arches vaulted the roaring gorge, uniting two warring provinces in unbroken commerce.

name: Elevated Mountain Water Aqueduct
description: Channel pure mountain headwaters across miles of arched stone arcades into urban fountains and baths.
creativePrompt: How does fresh mountain water transform public health and sanitation in the teeming city?
exampleNarrative: Tiered stone arcades carried a roaring river of crystal mountain water across the arid valley, feeding public fountains.

name: Colossal Stepped Wonder Pyramid
description: Quarry millions of limestone blocks to erect an awe-inspiring wonder pyramid visible for fifty leagues.
creativePrompt: Which ruler is interred beneath the golden capstone? What astronomical alignments does it measure?
exampleNarrative: A blinding white pyramid stepped toward the heavens, its golden apex catching the first rays of dawn before the earth below awoke.

name: Grand Domed Academy & Library
description: Endow a vast collegiate library with vaulted halls, botanical gardens, and lecture ampitheatres.
creativePrompt: What lost scrolls are preserved in the underground archive? What philosophical debates rage in the courtyards?
exampleNarrative: Beneath the monumental copper dome, thousands of scholars copied ancient codices and debated the geometry of the spheres.

name: Sky-Citadel & Grand Colossus
description: Construct a floating sky-citadel held aloft by ancient lodestones and guarded by an animated bronze colossus.
creativePrompt: How do citizens travel to the floating citadel? What power animates the thousand-foot guardian colossus?
exampleNarrative: Suspended among the clouds on anti-gravitic lodestones, the city hovered silently while its bronze guardian watched the world.
